insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹2L+ inferred from CB clause; ₹3L+ for hospital cash; ₹5L+ for reinstatement)

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day; proportionate deduction on associate medical expenses if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU/ICCU including intensivist, monitor and pulse oxymeter charges capped at 2% of SI per day

copayment.display: None (20% if Zone 2 insured treated in Zone 1)
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay for Zone 1 insureds; 20% co-pay applies only if Zone 2 insured opts lower zone and gets treated in Zone 1 (Maharashtra/Gujarat). Voluntary 20% co-pay optional for premium discount.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, modern treatments, ARMD, mental illness, genetic, puberty/menopause capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 20% of SI max ₹50k/eye; Modern treatments: 10–50% of SI with ₹caps; ARMD: 10% SI max ₹75k; Mental illness: 25% SI; Genetic: 25% SI; Puberty/menopause: 25% SI; Artificial life support: 10% SI max 15 days

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months continuous coverage; reducible via portability credit

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, stones, varicose veins, renal failure etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement, mental illness, ARMD, genetic disorders; 90-day list for diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Excl18 (except ectopic pregnancy). New born baby covered from birth within mother's SI if mother has 24 months continuous coverage.

cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of SI added per claim-free year, max 50%; reduced at same rate if claim made; applicable for SI ₹2L and above

restoration.note: Reinstatement of full SI once per insured per policy year after exhaustion; only for SI ₹5L+; not available for modern treatments; reinstated SI cannot be used for same illness/injury for which original SI was exhausted

day_care.display: Listed procedures (226 listed in Annexure I)
day_care.note: Extensive list of 226 day care procedures covered in Annexure I

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusion 4.4.17

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of donor covered (excluding cost of organ) within aggregate of SI and cumulative bonus of recipient

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges up to 1% of SI per insured event for emergency/ICU admission or inter-hospital transfer

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered with individual sub-limits ranging from 10% SI (max ₹50k–₹1L) to 50% SI (max ₹2.5L–₹5L) per policy period; not available under reinstated SI

consumables.note: Consumables like gloves, masks, etc. listed in Annexure II List I as non-payable items; many subsumed into room/procedure charges

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment only within India (clause 5.18 and exclusion 4.4.27)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud; moratorium resets for enhanced SI portion

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. No coverage during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies with term 1 year or more; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability and migration both available as per IRDAI guidelines

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary hospitalisation, acupressure/acupuncture, external prosthetics/hearing aids, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen, OPD procedures converted to IP, overseas treatment

optional_riders.display: Optional Cover I: Enhanced cataract limit (SI ₹8L+); Optional Cover II: Voluntary 20% co-pay for 15% premium discount
